## Checklist

- [ ] `dotnet build` and `dotnet test` pass.
- [ ] All code comments are in English; docs are bilingual; no emoji.

- [ ] No PCL source code, images, logos, or fonts were added.
- [ ] The PCL notice text in README, About view, and LICENSE is unchanged.

- [ ] Adjustable constants are marked with an `Adjustable` comment.
